question:
In the following figure series, select the figure which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives. ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a7a086f27490c74bf5675d7b5339c5baf2731bfce2cbac5f421138830353287.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: The outer U-shaped symbols rotate 45 degrees clockwise in each consecutive step, while the central circle and square remain fixed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7bee521ed84daab90332c89f3afe2f8c57c5e6b8e29152bd614581db1d2fb9f4.png] 

So far, Figures 1 to 4 show consecutive 45° clockwise rotations of all symbols.

The next figure will rotate the symbols another 45° clockwise, with the top symbol now facing Top-Right.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**
